contentList.content: Dealing[1] also pushes the enemy back [2], no more than once per attack. If the enemy is under Moleculation, its degree rises by one above the limit its source allows.

Smaller enemies under your Moleculation lose [1] reaction. Large enemies and bosses rise to the next degree of Moleculation at the start of each of their turns, twice as fast while Slowed or Hastened.
Hostile creatures you can see out of combat take a [1] penalty to Initiative.
Slowed enemies also take [1] from you.
The creature loses [1] reaction while it remains under Moleculation.

The creature rises to the next degree of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MOLECULATION_1">Moleculation</LSTag> at the start of each of its turns, twice as fast while <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SLOW">Slowed</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="HASTE">Hastened</LSTag>. Lasts while the creature remains under <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MOLECULATION_1">Moleculation</LSTag>.
